methodology.free_available: Read-only free USDT from KuCoin direct read-only account API.
methodology.active_deal_capital: Sum of known cost basis for active deals.
methodology.placed_order_reserve: Shown separately; not subtracted from free USDT because exchange free balance normally already excludes open-order funds.
methodology.remaining_active_deal_dca_reserve: Unplaced remaining safety-order ladder requirement for active deals.
methodology.enabled_idle_capacity_reserve: Potential exposure only: maximum full-ladder capital for unused enabled-bot deal slots. It is not labelled reserved and is not subtracted from deployable capital.
methodology.deployable_capital: free_available minus remaining active-deal DCA reserve after KuCoin↔provider reconciliation. Provider-stale deals proven closed on KuCoin do not keep capital reserved.

capital_headline.explanation: KuCoin cash is the exchange free balance. Reserved capital protects remaining DCA orders for reconciled active trades. Safe to allocate is cash remaining after that protection.

capital_policy: Protect only reconciled active-deal remaining DCA ladders; provider-stale deals proven closed on KuCoin do not consume CRM capital. Idle theoretical exposure is not reserved until approved.
